name: How do I choose the right provider for a GEO website audit?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right provider for a GEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a provider, look for experience in local SEO and a proven track record with businesses similar to yours. Inquire about their process, the tools they use, and what a typical audit report includes. Ensure they offer clear, actionable recommendations and can explain their findings in an understandable way. Client testimonials and case studies specifically related to local search success are also good indicators of a reputable provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a provider with local SEO experience, a clear process, actionable recommendations, and relevant client testimonials.
